name: token-burner
description: AI 驱动的新闻简报收集和展示平台

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.daily: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python cli.py daily
scripts.collect: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python cli.py collect
scripts.briefing: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python cli.py briefing
scripts.stats: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python cli.py stats
scripts.refetch: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && python cli.py refetch
